liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Truckin'** (1 review): Over 60,000 fans went wild during the performance of this song [25]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-07-16.158164.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 185 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd90-07-16.sbd.knapp.1316.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 25 songs; 177 min; rated 4.48/5 by 50 [3]. Said about its sound: The audio quality is rated as A+ by the listener; The music jumps out at the listener on this high-quality tape; Laughing and church bell sounds are present in the Space section [25][28][31][34]
- **gd1990-07-16.fob.alabamabob.andrewf.95580.flac16**: audience recording; 24 songs; 169 min; rated 3.67/5 by 6 [5]. Said about its sound: Four tiny skips occur in Sugar Magnolia and five minutes are missing from Drums [5]
- **gd1990-07-16.Nak100sSenn421.Hill.Keo.131228.Flac1644**: audience recording; 24 songs; 174 min [10]. Said about its sound: Higher recording levels are noted near the end of Sunshine Daydream [10]

## Around the show

- Police were mellow and did not bother attendees during the long hot day [26]
- A shooting star crossed the sky during the performance of The Wheel [27]
- Nearly a thousand people gathered in the shopping mall parking lot [32]
- CSN played a set with Brent watching from the wings before the Dead [33]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-07-16.158164.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  August 28, 2022; source: Ultramatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-X90) [1]
- **gd90-07-16.sbd.knapp.1316.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD -> DAT -> CD's -> EAC -> SHN [3]
- **gd1990-07-16.fob.alabamabob.andrewf.95580.flac16**: taped by Alabama Bob; transferred by Andrew F.; source: FOB AUD: Sennheiser MD-441's > Sony TC-D5M > TDK SA 90's with no Dolby. Mics on stand, 18th row FOB. [5]
- **gd1990-07-16.Nak100sSenn421.Hill.Keo.131228.Flac1644**: taped by Steve Hill; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Steve Hill, Transfer By Keo; 2 Nakamichi CM100/CP4 Shotguns + 1 Sennheiser 421 > Unknown Mixer (Either A Radio Shack Or Boss) 1/4… [10]
